description: Converts validated designs into process plans across manufacturing methods. (Proposed capability.)

(Proposed capability.) A manufacturing translator would take a validated design and emit process plans for additive, machining, molding, assembly, and inspection with cost comparison. Single-process planners are demonstrated; a universal cross-process translator is simulated. Status: simulated. Capability status: PROPOSED. This database describes a proposed capability, not a completed product. Status taxonomy used throughout: speculative (no demonstrated path), simulated (works in simulation only), experimentally-demonstrated (lab demo exists), independently-verified (reproduced by a third party). Generating a design cannot make impossible physics possible; every record states which status its claims carry. Capability status for this tool: simulated.

title: Universal Manufacturing Translator — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Converts validated designs into process plans across manufacturing methods. (Proposed capability.)
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Universal Manufacturing Translator, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Design-feature to process mapping). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Design-feature to process mapping and Multi-process plan generation. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Manufacturing process planner) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else. Capability status for this tool: simulated.
